label: TEST: CX-8 rig and local test stack only. Not an owner decision and not a product default.

AGENTS_ROUTING_TABLE.note: LOCAL TEST rates per million tokens, in TEST USDT, for every task the default table routes. Not product prices (OWNER 107: blank in production).

AGENTS_COACH_ROUTE.note: LOCAL TEST Coach route on the stand-in engine, billed 0 (OWNER 108), appended to AGENTS_ROUTING_TABLE. No Coach rate is published; LOCAL_STACK_AGENTS_COACH_ROUTE=off leaves the Coach with no model.

AGENTS_FEE_ASSET_ID.note: The asset a usage window settles in.

AGENTS_USAGE_WINDOW_MINUTES.note: How long one usage window stays open before it settles.

AGENTS_METERING_ENABLED.note: Metering on, so a run charges TEST USDT through the ledger.

AGENTS_TIER_LAWS.note: LOCAL TEST tier law for the scanner, navigator and support doors: every verified tier gets every read tool and 5 scanner signals (owner decision). Not a product grant; blank in production, where each door refuses tier_law_blank.

AGENTS_MOCK_DELAY_MS.note: LOCAL TEST: the test engine answers after 0.8 s, so two runs started together are both in flight (J-agents-02 #3). Not a product value.

AGENTS_LOG_READ_REASONS.note: LOCAL TEST reasons an operator picks to read a customer's agent log. Not an owner decision (blank in production refuses agents.log_read_reason_unset).

AGENTS_OPS_ACTIONS_LIMIT.note: LOCAL TEST rows per operator log read or export. Not an owner decision (blank refuses agents.ops_actions_limit_unset).

AGENTS_REGISTRY_LIST_LIMIT.note: LOCAL TEST rows per operator fleet registry read (J-agents-14). Not an owner decision (blank refuses agents.registry_list_limit_unset).

AGENTS_BACKGROUND_TEST_STEPS.note: LOCAL TEST steps of one background test run of an own agent (J-agents-14 #3). Not an owner decision (blank refuses agents.background_unset).

AGENTS_BACKGROUND_STEP_MS.note: LOCAL TEST length of one background step, so a run is still going when a journey quarantines its agent (J-agents-14 #3). Not an owner decision (blank refuses agents.background_unset).

AGENTS_POLICY_BASELINE.note: LOCAL TEST managed baseline for own agents' tools (AG-guardrails-02): per class, the loosest standing choice a person's rule may take, so a rule to act without asking on own or market data is refused as loosening it (J-agents-05 #1). Not an owner decision (blank in production refuses agents.baseline_value_unset).

AGENTS_TRANSCRIPT_RETENTION_DAYS.note: LOCAL TEST days an engine call's prompt text is kept for a transcript read. Not an owner decision (blank keeps none and refuses agents.transcript_retention_unset).

AGENTS_OWN_TOKEN_LIFETIME_MINUTES.note: LOCAL TEST lifetime of an own agent's token (AG-identity-01; J-agents-03 #5). Not an owner decision; production stays blank and issuing refuses agents.identity.lifetime_unset. LOCAL_STACK_AGENTS_TOKEN_LIFETIME=off leaves it blank.

AGENTS_OWN_ASSISTANT_MODEL.note: LOCAL TEST: the drafting assistant on the TEST engine, which drafts by rule and calls no model (AG-builder-03; J-agents-03 #6). Not the owner's model choice; production stays blank and drafting refuses owner.decision. LOCAL_STACK_AGENTS_ASSISTANT_MODEL=off leaves it blank.

AGENTS_REVIEWER_MODEL.note: LOCAL TEST: the automatic reviewer of own agents on the TEST engine, which reviews by rule and calls no model (AG-approvals-02; J-agents-05 #7). Not the owner's model choice; production stays blank and every call the reviewer would decide goes to the person (owner.decision). LOCAL_STACK_AGENTS_REVIEWER_MODEL=off leaves it blank.

AGENTS_APPROVAL_TTL_SECONDS.note: LOCAL TEST seconds a held own-agent call waits for the person's decision before it reads expired (AG-approvals-01; J-agents-05 #5 #6). Not an owner decision; production stays blank and holding a call refuses agents.approval.ttl_unset. LOCAL_STACK_AGENTS_APPROVAL_TTL=off leaves it blank; =short uses AGENTS_APPROVAL_TTL_SECONDS_SHORT.

AGENTS_APPROVAL_TTL_SECONDS_SHORT.note: LOCAL TEST short wait, so a journey can watch a held call expire (J-agents-05 #6) on a restart with LOCAL_STACK_AGENTS_APPROVAL_TTL=short. Never an owner value.
